data: Five fictional activity documents, 30 sections; no internal resident data
model_route: OpenAI via locally authenticated Codex CLI

caps.continuation: Explicit product-lead approval, appended audit; counters never reset

cases.heldout_selection: Purposive new combinations of known synthetic source facts; not an independent-domain or population benchmark

arms.agentic_dense: Actual MCP retrieval; initial top_k=3, tool accepts 1..6, at most 4 searches
arms.bm25: One local BM25 selection, top_k=3; k1=1.2, b=0.75
arms.full_context: All 30 sections provided; no retrieval or tools, retrieval metrics N/A

measurement: Fact evidence OR-of-AND groups; document+section dedup; incomplete relevance labels disable precision/recall; separate source/citation/execution prerequisites and provisional semantic criteria
failure_policy: Preserve all attempts; no content retries or prompt/gold tuning for higher scores; explicit infrastructure correction is versioned
technical_correction: Confirmed cosmetic unstable-feature notice was rejected as an unresolved error. Suppress only that notice in isolated commands; all other errors/tools still fail. Raw private notice deleted and not exported.
reproducibility_limits: Provider model alias/weights and internal HTTP request counts are not fully observable.
Different context/search budgets are part of the arm methods; extra agent context is not evidence of a better embedding model.
Shared dense-index setup is excluded from per-case time; agent MCP startup is included.
A literal valid citation does not prove semantic support.
Small synthetic exploratory set and AI reference do not establish general reliability or human calibration.
Generator and grader use the same model route/family and may share errors; separate sessions do not establish independent semantic judgement. No additional model variant was introduced.
resume_policy: The14 heldout rows skipped without a reservation at the expired window are resumed only after explicit product-lead authorization. The initial partial file is retained. Earlier failed judgements are never replaced.
timing_limitations: Timeouts are configured at120seconds per model session. Gaps between recorded OS timestamps were observed; their cause is not established. The runner refused new reservations after its recorded deadline.
